title: Learning Random Geometric Graphs Drawn in Probabilistic Metric Spaces
abstract: arXiv:2608.19082v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We present a new data-driven learning of a Random Geometric Graph (RGG) of a multivariate dataset, where the graph is drawn in a probabilistic metric space. This graph learning works for generic datasets, irrespective of the type of the observables; their probability distributions; or size of the data. We identify a metric of the space that the graph is drawn in, as a probability distribution of a random variable that we introduce, namely, a variable that represents the disparity between the connectedness of two vertices of the graph, and the correlation between the two random variables that are attached to the respective vertex. It is the closed-form {\it{cdf}} of this disparity variable that we advance as the distance function of the host space of the learnt RGG, such that the edge exists between any two nodes, if this inter-nodal distance falls short of a chosen cutoff probability. translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.19082v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：我们提出了一种新的数据驱动学习方法，用于学习多元数据集的随机几何图（RGG），其中图是在概率度量空间中绘制的。这种图学习方法适用于通用数据集，无论观测变量的类型、其概率分布或数据大小如何。我们确定了图所在空间的一个度量，即我们引入的一个随机变量的概率分布，该变量表示图中两个顶点连通性与附着在各自顶点上的两个随机变量之间的相关性之间的差异。我们提出将该差异变量的闭式累积分布函数（cdf）作为学习到的RGG宿主空间的距离函数，使得如果任意两个节点之间的节点间距离小于选定的截止概率，则它们之间存在边。在这种概率空间中绘制RGG导致了...
tldr: 本文提出了一种在概率度量空间中学习随机几何图的新方法，通过定义差异变量的闭式累积分布函数作为距离函数，适用于任意类型和规模的多元数据集。
en_tdlr: This paper presents a novel method for learning random geometric graphs in probabilistic metric spaces, using the closed-form CDF of a disparity variable as the distance function, applicable to arbitrary multivariate datasets.
